column1: # Original DICE TV Basketball, play-time potentiometer 10 kOhm (the minimum). Two coins (300, 1300 ms)
# buy a four-player game, Start (1850 ms) begins it. Each of the four paddles held at both ends alone
# (2000-4050 ms) moves only its own player. Recorded closed-loop four-player play (4500-28000 ms) scores
# for both teams. A coin in play (30000 ms) clears the scores and restarts the clock as a two-player
# game; recorded play (31000-45000 ms), then the paddles rest until the timer ends the game. One coin
# (106000 ms) and Start (107500 ms) restart a two-player game. Original SDL int16 axes.
